name: kmacmcfarlane
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Kyle McFarlane — dev tooling and reusable skills.

plugins.name: kit-dev
plugins.description: Maintainer tooling for this plugin ecosystem — skill creation, project scaffolding, upstream kit sync, and factoring analysis.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Context survival for long sessions — depth gate, checkpoint workflow, session rehydration, and token-spend reporting from the local transcripts (soft dependency: statusline, for exact depth).

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Always-on status line — context left, plan usage limits, model and session name at a glance (optional: works with context-guard, which adds its epoch and checkpoint thresholds to the gauge).

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, multi-agent research fan-outs, chain-of-verification fact-checking, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependency: work-items).

plugins.name: work-items
plugins.description: Repo-durable work items for humans and agents — the wi CLI over one-markdown-file-per-item stores, and the work-source provider interface.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Conversational skills — structured product research and purchase recommendations.

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Isolated execution for Claude Code sessions — configure, bootstrap and troubleshoot claude-sandbox containers, with the checkout/worktree convention their launcher follows enforced by a PreToolUse guard.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Unattended agent loops over a backlog — the backlog.yaml workflow for ralph runs. Requires the claude-sandbox tool (see the sandbox plugin); consumes a work source through the work-source interface, with backlog.yaml as the default provider.
